responses.strategy: Saving all your edits for giant commit will become a real problem later is because you won't know what specific problem you fixed or how you fix it because they are in one. You will be lost for not knowing where to start or even begin looking.
responses.clue: What you should make multiple commits instead of one before Friday's demo to be able to see the history of the many changes you made. This will leave checkpoints you can return to and seek specific changes.
